text:
maria: Heads-up — nightly long-context perf run shows sharp latency cliff at ~00:00:08. nsys capture uploaded: https://perf/1979994444/nsys and perfetto trace: https://perfetto/trace/1979994444. I see repeated cudaMalloc spikes (~1.8–3.2ms each) during token emission for sequences > 4096. Kernel timeline shows selector flipping variants mid-request. :eyes:
kevin: Can you paste the nsys slice? did you add nvtx markers around batcher and kv cache?
maria: yes nvtx markers were added. Important bits: kernel 'fmha_opt' used early, then selector chooses 'matmul_generic' at ~7600ms; workspace allocs happen right after. Perf numbers: tail latency jumped from 42ms -> 180ms for some tokens.
sasha: quick hypothesis — arena reclaim kicks in when KV cache occupancy dips, causing many small allocations that fall back to cudamallocasync. That causes the allocation stall you see. Did the run have batching changed?
maria: batcher config was default adaptive (target 4, max 12). I did a debug run forcing batch_size=1 and still saw sporadic mallocs, but much less frequent. With batcher=8, spikes became deterministic.
kevin: did you run with our cuda-mem-sampler? can you paste sample output?
maria: pasted snippet below:
```
$ tools/cuda-mem-sampler --pid 23456 --interval 1ms --dur 30s
alloc@0x7f8a: cudaMalloc 2.1ms
alloc@0x7f8a: cudaMalloc 2.5ms
free@0x7f8a: cudaFree 0.05ms
alloc@0x7f8b: cudaMallocAsync 0.9ms
alloc@0x7f8a: cudaMalloc 3.0ms
```
kevin: flamegraph from perfetto shows compute streams idle while allocation stalls. So it's not a compute-side kernel; it's allocation path blocking.
ajit: I replayed the capture. Kernel selector cost model currently favors lower FLOP variants for long seq but doesn't account for workspace growth. For seq_len>4096 and batch<=4, chosen variant has O(seq^2) workspace -> triggers pool exhaustion and falls back to cudaMalloc path. That aligns with your observations.
sasha: possible mitigations: 1) increase small-slab size to reduce number of small allocations, 2) preallocate workspace_pool for high-seq paths, 3) tweak batching heuristic to prefer smaller per-request sequence packing for long-context flows. I prototyped arena tuning: set arena.small_slab_kb=128, arena.min_free_fraction=0.05.
maria: PR posted with config snippet and an eager_kv_warmup flag: https://git/repo/pull/4321. Snippet:
```
runtime.arena:
  small_slab_kb: 128
  min_free_fraction: 0.05
runtime.kv:
  eager_warmup: true
  warmup_bytes: 268435456
```
kevin: ran a short canary with that patch. kv hit ratio improved from 58% -> 78% under batcher=6, cudaMalloc spikes reduced by ~75%. tail latency improved but not fully resolved (still occasional 120–150ms spikes).
ajit: we should also update kernel selector to add a workspace_cost term. Proposed score = latency_est + alpha * workspace_bytes. Alpha tuned from offline runs. Without it selector will keep choosing variants that look fast but blow up memory usage.
perf-bot: auto-alert: memory_allocation_spike detected on host-gpu-12 at 1979994444 (threshold 1.5ms). Samples collected: 102 (1% sampling).
sasha: agree on selector change. I can add workspace_cost and a heuristic that prefers preallocated-workspace variants when arena.available < N. Also add NVTX tag around selector decision to make future traces easier.
maria: next steps: 1) land arena tuning PR (4321) 2) land selector cost model change (4324) 3) run 2h nightly with --case=long_context --nsys --perfetto --nvtx and sample rate 5% for allocator events 4) schedule canary with 10% traffic to dedicated pool. I'll coordinate with infra for longer captures (perfetto needs increased retention).
kevin: I'll prepare the perf deck with before/after traces. Also adding a quick reproducer: `tools/repro_long_ctx.sh --batcher 8 --seq 8192 --steps 500`.
ajit: note — On GPUs older than A100 the workspace growth multiplier is larger; add platform-specific penalty in selector.
maria: filing follow-ups in issue tracker and tagging infra for trace retention. Thanks all, let's sync tomorrow at 11 for canary plan. :thumbsup:
